company_notes:
Summary: Marsden is evaluating Redwood Dedicated for latency-sensitive conversational agents powering customer support and fraud triage. They want guaranteed throughput for peak trading hours and strong data controls.

Key constraints / asks:
- Must support VPC deployment with KMS-managed keys; legal requires proof of key rotation policies.
- Data residency: primary EU + fallbacks in NA for DR. Sensitive PII must not leave customer-controlled storage.
- SLA conversations: looking for 99.95% availability, p95 latency targets per model tier, and burn-rate protection for traffic spikes.

Model & routing preferences:
- Prefer starting on 13B dense variant for most routes; desire optional 70B quantized for high-recall workflows.
- Need automatic fallback to smaller model (7B) if capacity constrained.
- Multi-region routing: EU primary, NA fallback during EU maintenance windows.

Sizing requirements discussed in workshop:
- Baseline steady-state: 18 QPS of chat inference (average 80 tokens per request).
- Peak: up to 120 QPS sustained for 10–15 minute bursts during market opens.
- Token/sec target: steady ~14.4k tokens/sec, burst up to 96k tokens/sec.
- Target latency SLOs: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 220ms for short prompts (<128 tokens); p95 budget for long-form generation (512 tokens) is 1.2s.
- Throughput guarantee ask: predictable reserved slots for concurrent KV/cache-warmed sessions.

POC scope & success criteria:
- 2-week POC using Dedicated reserve in EU region, replicate peak burst pattern at 80% of target QPS for stability tests.
- Verify autoscale fallback behavior, model routing, and KV cache warmup time under simulated traffic.
- Security review: complete SOC2 self-attestation and provide HSM/KMS integration proof.

Notes from conversations: 
- "We need predictable tail latency during market open spikes — variability is the killer." — Head of Platform (call 2024-10-28).
- AE notes: pricing sensitivity around GPU family selection; finance prefers fixed monthly commit vs usage overages.
- Infra: wants exported metrics for Prometheus + token-level cost breakdown in console.

Next steps (short):
- Send dedicated sizing worksheet (Ethan) by 2024-11-04.
- Schedule hands-on sizing workshop (2h) with infra + security + ML eng (target week of 2024-11-11).
- Legal to confirm KMS/HSM requirements and data residency checklist.
